newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's BDET bank H1 profit down.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's BDET bank H1 profit down.

text.p: Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie (BDET) net profits during the first half of 1996 dropped to 490,000 dinars from 1.58 million dinars during the same period last year, results published on Monday showed.
The state-controlled bank specialises in loans for development projects.
It has a capital of 50 million dinars and is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange. Its share was last priced at 20.81 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
